title: PivotOPD: Learning to Recover from Pivotal Mistakes in Multi-Turn Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.40285v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a promising approach for training language agents, providing dense teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, in multi-turn interaction, an incorrect action changes the states the student encounters later, so errors compound across turns. In preliminary experiments across three Qwen3 models (8B to 235B), we find that more than half of the failed rollouts contain a pivotal mistake, an action that moves the agent farther from completing the task, and this mistake typically occurs early. These pivotal mistakes often remain recoverable: guiding the model for only a few turns after the pivotal turn can restore task success. We therefore propose PivotOPD, an on-policy distillation framework that jointly trains the student to prevent pivotal mistakes and to recover from the states they create. translated_title: PivotOPD：学习从多轮智能体中的关键错误中恢复
translated_abstract: 在策略蒸馏（OPD）是训练语言智能体的一种有前景的方法，它能够对学生模型生成的轨迹提供密集的教师监督。然而，在多轮交互中，一个错误的动作会改变学生模型后续遇到的状态，因此错误会跨轮次不断累积。在针对三个Qwen3模型（8B至235B）的初步实验中，我们发现超过一半的失败轨迹中都包含一个“关键错误”，即一个使智能体偏离任务完成方向的动作，而且这种错误通常发生在早期阶段。这些关键错误往往仍是可以挽回的：在关键轮次之后仅对模型进行几轮引导，就能恢复任务的成功。因此，我们提出PivotOPD，这是一个在策略蒸馏框架，它联合训练学生模型去预防关键错误，并从关键错误所产生的状态中恢复。在每个关键错误发生时，教师模型会提供一个黄金动作，然后再指定一个恢复动作……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出PivotOPD在策略蒸馏框架，联合训练学生模型预防多轮交互中早期出现的关键错误，并学习从这些错误造成的状态中恢复，从而显著提升语言智能体多轮任务的成功率。
en_tdlr: PivotOPD is an on-policy distillation framework that jointly trains student agents to prevent pivotal mistakes in multi-turn interactions and to recover from the states those mistakes create, significantly improving task success rates.
